method: membership: per-provider free-tier rules over the catalog snapshot; quality = 0.35*size + 0.30*paid-price-of-same-model + 0.15*recency + 0.10*reasoning + 0.10*context (+coder bonus); speed = 0.6*provider prior + 0.4*small-active-params; limits = published free-tier caps

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: LPU inference, very fast; ~1000 requests/day per model

google.name: Google AI Studio
google.note: Gemini Flash free tier (per-model daily caps), Gemma generous

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: :free models — 20 RPM, 50 RPD (1000 RPD after a one-time $10 credit)

nvidia.name: NVIDIA NIM
nvidia.note: Large open models; 40 RPM; one tool call per turn

huggingface.name: Hugging Face
huggingface.note: Monthly inference credits via the router

ollama-cloud.name: Ollama Cloud
ollama-cloud.note: Free tier with hourly/daily usage caps

github-models.name: GitHub Models
github-models.note: Fine-grained PAT with models:read; small daily caps, 8k context
